mapper.sql:
-- Delivery Site
AND SDELIVERY.SALFCY_0 IN ('ZHU', 'HKG', 'YSH', 'GZH')
AND SDELIVERY.SALFCY_0 = #{Site}
AND SDELIVERY.BETFCY_0 = 2GBVM,C
AND SDELIVERY.BETFCY_0 = 1

-- Delivery Date
AND SDELIVERYD.SHIDAT_0 >= CONVERT(DATE, #{DateFrom}, 23)
AND CONVERT(Date, #{DateTo}, 23) > SDELIVERYD.SHIDAT_0
AND SORDERQ.YSOQ_DLIVP_0 >= CONVERT(DATE, #{DateFrom}, 23)
AND CONVERT(DATE, #{DateTo}, 23) > SORDERQ.YSOQ_DLIVP_0
AND SDELIVERYD.SHIDAT_0 >= CONVERT(DATE, #{DateFrom}, 23)
AND CONVERT(Date, #{DateTo}, 23) > SDELIVERYD.SHIDAT_0

SELECT DISTINCT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY SDELIVERY.SALFCY_0 DESC, SDELIVERYD.SHIDAT_0 DESC ) AS ItemNO,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY SDELIVERY.SALFCY_0 DESC, SORDERQ.YSOQ_DLIVP_0 DESC ) AS ItemNO,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY SDELIVERY.SALFCY_0 DESC, SDELIVERYD.SHIDAT_0 DESC ) AS ItemNO,
SDELIVERY.SALFCY_0 AS OrderSite, SDELIVERYD.SDHNUM_0 AS DeliveryNO, SDELIVERYD.SDDLIN_0 AS DeliveryLine, SDELIVERYD.SOHNUM_0 AS OrderNO, SDELIVERYD.SOPLIN_0 AS OrderLine, CASE WHEN SORDERQ.YSOQ_STA_0 = 1 THEN SORDER.SOHTYP_0 + '-Methods' WHEN SORDERQ.YSOQ_STA_0 = 2 THEN SORDER.SOHTYP_0 + '-InteralProd' WHEN SORDERQ.YSOQ_STA_0 = 3 THEN SORDER.SOHTYP_0 + '-ExternalProd' WHEN SORDERQ.YSOQ_STA_0 = 4 THEN SORDER.SOHTYP_0 + '-Design' WHEN SORDERQ.YSOQ_STA_0 = 5 THEN SORDER.SOHTYP_0 + '-Stock' WHEN SORDERQ.YSOQ_STA_0 = 6 THEN SORDER.SOHTYP_0 + '-Trading' WHEN SORDERQ.YSOQ_STA_0 = 7 THEN SORDER.SOHTYP_0 + '-Services' WHEN SORDERQ.YSOQ_STA_0 = 8 THEN SORDER.SOHTYP_0 + '-SalesAdmin' ELSE SORDER.SOHTYP_0 + '-UNK' END AS OrderAssignStatus, SORDERQ.ORDDAT_0 AS OrderDate, SORDERQ.YSOQ_DLIVP_0 AS DeliveryPlanDate, SDELIVERYD.SHIDAT_0 AS ShipDate, SORDERQ.YSOH_PJT_0 AS ProjectNO, SORDERQ.YSOQ_PJTORI_0 AS OriProjectNO, SORDER.CUSORDREF_0 AS CustomerOrderNO,
SDELIVERY.CUR_0 AS Currency, SDELIVERYD.NETPRINOT_0 AS NetPrice, -- Tax definition error cause NetPriceWithTax is not equal to NetPrice + Tax IIF ( SDELIVERYD.NETPRIATI_0 > 0, SDELIVERYD.NETPRIATI_0, SDELIVERYD.NETPRINOT_0 ) AS NetPriceWithTax, SDELIVERYD.NETPRINOT_0 * SDELIVERYD.QTY_0 AS LineAmount, IIF ( SDELIVERYD.NETPRIATI_0 > 0, SDELIVERYD.NETPRIATI_0 * SDELIVERYD.QTY_0, SDELIVERYD.NETPRINOT_0 * SDELIVERYD.QTY_0 ) AS LineAmountWithTax, SDELIVERYD.QTY_0 AS Qty, SDELIVERYD.STU_0 AS Unit FROM EXPLOIT.SDELIVERY SDELIVERY INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SDELIVERYD SDELIVERYD ON SDELIVERYD.SDHNUM_0 = SDELIVERY.SDHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERQ SORDERQ ON SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 = SDELIVERYD.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERQ.SOPLIN_0 = SDELIVERYD.SOPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERP SORDERP ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SDELIVERYD.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 = SDELIVERYD.SOPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDER SORDER ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0
WHERE 1 = 1
mapper.select: ORDER BY OrderSite DESC, ItemNO ASC, ProjectNO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT DISTINCT COUNT(1) AS Total FROM EXPLOIT.SDELIVERY SDELIVERY INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SDELIVERYD SDELIVERYD ON SDELIVERYD.SDHNUM_0 = SDELIVERY.SDHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERQ SORDERQ ON SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 = SDELIVERYD.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERQ.SOPLIN_0 = SDELIVERYD.SOPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERP SORDERP ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SDELIVERYD.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 = SDELIVERYD.SOPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDER SORDER ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0
WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT DISTINCT SDELIVERY.SALFCY_0 AS OrderSite, SDELIVERYD.SDHNUM_0 AS DeliveryNO, SDELIVERYD.SDDLIN_0 AS DeliveryLine, SORDERQ.ORDDAT_0 AS OrderDate, SORDERQ.YSOQ_DLIVP_0 AS DeliveryPlanDate, SDELIVERYD.SHIDAT_0 AS ShipDate,
SDELIVERY.CUR_0 AS Currency, SORDERP.NETPRINOT_0 * SORDERQ.QTY_0 AS SalesAmount, SDELIVERYD.NETPRINOT_0 * SDELIVERYD.QTY_0 AS DeliveryAmount, IIF ( SDELIVERYD.NETPRIATI_0 > 0, SDELIVERYD.NETPRIATI_0 * SDELIVERYD.QTY_0, SDELIVERYD.NETPRINOT_0 * SDELIVERYD.QTY_0 ) AS DeliveryAmountWithTax FROM EXPLOIT.SDELIVERY SDELIVERY INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SDELIVERYD SDELIVERYD ON SDELIVERYD.SDHNUM_0 = SDELIVERY.SDHNUM_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERQ SORDERQ ON SORDERQ.SOHNUM_0 = SDELIVERYD.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERQ.SOPLIN_0 = SDELIVERYD.SOPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDERP SORDERP ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SDELIVERYD.SOHNUM_0 AND SORDERP.SOPLIN_0 = SDELIVERYD.SOPLIN_0 INNER JOIN EXPLOIT.SORDER SORDER ON SORDERP.SOHNUM_0 = SORDER.SOHNUM_0
WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT T00.*,
FORMAT (Year (T00.ShipDate), '0000') AS Target
FORMAT (Year (T00.DeliveryPlanDate), '0000') AS Target
FORMAT (Year (T00.ShipDate), '0000') AS Target
FORMAT (Year (T00.ShipDate), '0000') + '-' + FORMAT (MONTH (T00.ShipDate), '00') AS Target
FORMAT (Year (T00.DeliveryPlanDate), '0000') + '-' + FORMAT (MONTH (T00.DeliveryPlanDate), '00') AS Target
FORMAT (Year (T00.ShipDate), '0000') + '-' + FORMAT (MONTH (T00.ShipDate), '00') AS Target
FORMAT (Year (T00.ShipDate), '0000') AS Target
FROM T00
mapper.select:
WITH T00 AS ( )
ORDER BY T00.OrderSite DESC, Target ASC
